case_title: Devilal And Others v. State of Madhya Pradesh
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302 r/w 34; Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 ss.3(1)(10), 3(2)(5)
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 302 r/w 34 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment with fine
neutral_facts: The accused, along with another individual, assaulted the victim during a confrontation. The victim sustained severe injuries, including cuts to his legs and facial trauma, and was later found dead. The police recorded a First Information Report (FIR) based on the victim's dying declaration. Witnesses testified that the accused attacked the victim with weapons, leading to his death. Medical evidence indicated the victim was alive when the initial examination was conducted, and the FIR was considered a valid dying declaration. The prosecution's case was supported by witness statements and the recovery of weapons used in the assault.
